_approach: The deepest swing in the set -- MPC 66% (engine 0.32) -- for the dusty, off-the-grid Detroit feel Moodymann and Theo Parrish built their house records on: a soft kick, a ghosted snare surrounded by low-velocity ghost hits instead of a clean clap, sparse swung hats and a constant low shaker bed. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
